prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1337
Claimant:
Theresa Allen
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
6 Oct 2025
First notice of loss came in from the policyholder's side after a side impact at a signalized intersection, with the
claimant listed as a passenger in the vehicle struck on the driver's side. The claimant is represented by counsel, so all
further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
10 Oct 2025
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of the collision. Nothing in
the file points to any damage existing before coverage began.
4 Dec 2025
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and describes the crash in line with
the initial account. Officer notes were consistent with the driver's statement.
7 Dec 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who gave the same description of the light sequence and the point of impact. Their
account matches what was reported at first notice.
14 Dec 2025
Reviewed scene photos and the vehicle damage profile. The crush pattern and panel damage line up with a side
impcat of the type described.
11 Jan 2026
Collected statements from two independent witnesses. Both recall the collision and the vehicle positions the same
way the other parties have described them.
7 Feb 2026
Claimant's counsel sent the initial medical summary reporting a concussion diagnosed at the emergency department
after the crash. The injury profile fits the force and direction of the impact.
11 Feb 2026
Requested prior medical records. No earlier injury to the same body area appears in the history provided, and the
claimant reports no prior head trauma.
30 Mar 2026
Treatment followed a typical course, with follow-up visits and symptom checks that gradually decreased as the
claimant improved. Treating provider notes show steady recovery.
31 Mar 2026
Spoke with the claimant through counsel. The account of the crash, including the sequence and seating position, was
the same as in every eariler conversation.
1 May 2026
Reviewed repair estimates and the shop's inspection. No earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded, and the repairs
address only the collision damage.
3 May 2026
Current status: liability and damage are established, the bodily injury claim is being evaluated based on the medical
record, and the file is set for counsel's demand package.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
